mapper.insert: insert into airdrop (title, coupon_id, total_count, remain_count, start_time, end_time, status, create_time, update_time) values (#{title}, #{couponId}, #{totalCount}, #{remainCount}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update:
update airdrop
title = #{title},
coupon_id = #{couponId},
total_count = #{totalCount},
remain_count = #{remainCount},
start_time = #{startTime},
end_time = #{endTime},
status = #{status},
update_time = #{updateTime}
where id = #{id}
mapper.select:
select * from airdrop
and title like concat('%',#{title},'%')
and status = #{status}
order by update_time desc, id desc
